description: Land Title Settlement Department - Udamalwattam, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420350
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property rights. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
